Dashboard

Validation record

Validated 25 November 2026.

Automated checks

npm test: 20 JavaScript tests and 10 Python tests passed. npm run build succeeded. No npm dependencies are required.

  • Headline totals reconcile to individual records; weighted rates and zero denominators behave correctly.
  • Python and JavaScript model predictions match across all 156 training/holdout examples.
  • Identical and conflicting duplicates, orphan comments, dates, missing/negative/nonfinite metrics, invalid retention, experiment IDs and trend bounds are covered.
  • CSV handling covers BOM, quoted commas, escaped quotes, multiline fields, malformed rows, header-only schemas and formula-like export text.
  • A/B tests cover exact expected permutation results and exclusion of incompatible pairs.
  • Forecast tests verify elapsed-day spacing and minimum sample requirements.

Browser checks

  • Overview rendered at desktop width (1440 pixels), tablet-sized app panel and mobile width (390 pixels).
  • All six views fit a 390-pixel viewport without document-level horizontal overflow. Wide tables scroll inside their containers.
  • Burnout topic filter updated totals to 44.5K views, 138 attributed follows and 73.3% relatability.
  • Live comment analysis, content search and post-detail dialog worked.
  • JSON import succeeded with 24 posts and 720 comments.
  • Raw CSV import succeeded, removing one duplicate post, one duplicate comment and one empty comment.
  • Negative views caused a visible validation error and did not replace the active dataset.
  • A/B results displayed 12 pairs, p = 0.0820 and an inconclusive outcome.
  • Current-campaign export produced download feedback. No browser warning/error logs were recorded during these checks.

Artifact checks

The six-page strategy report and thirteen-page content playbook were rendered and visually reviewed. All twelve PNG cards were inspected. The deployment archive and full-project archive are checked with ZIP CRC validation during packaging.

Repository preparation

Regression tests cover empty exports replacing stale CSV records. Builds recreate dist and verify every source asset, model/data parity, PDF signatures and PNG dimensions. GitHub CI runs these checks and packages the deliverables.

Boundaries

No hosted deployment, authenticated social API or real audience campaign was tested. Demo results remain synthetic. Model accuracy is from a small authored holdout, not an independently collected benchmark. Imports are session-local. Ready-to-post cards are supplied; video scripts still require filming and editing.
